item.title: Utah Department of Natural Resources K-9 helps rescue woman suffering mental crisis
item.description: One of the law enforcement K-9s with the Utah Department of Natural Resources was instrumental in rescuing a woman who wandered off during a mental health episode last month.

item.title: Real Salt Lake set to open MLS season at Vancouver Whitecaps, aiming for strong start
item.description: Real Salt Lake kicks off its 2026 Major League Soccer season this Saturday on the road against the reigning Western Conference champion Vancouver Whitecaps.

item.title: Republican-backed group submits signatures to repeal Utah redistricting law
item.description: Over the past two months, volunteers and organizers have been collecting signatures to repeal Prop. 4, which established an independent redistricting commission to draw Utah’s congressional lines.
